name: S&F Foods, Inc.
old_description: Manufacturing for institutional school foodservice programs and retail since 2003.
about:
S&F Foods, Inc. is a frozen food manufacturer headquartered in Romulus, Michigan, founded in 2003. The company specializes in producing enrobed and topped items for institutional school foodservice programs and retail markets nationwide.

The company operates a 37,000-square-foot facility capable of high- and low-volume production. Its enrobed line fills and par-bakes hand-held pocket items, mixes hot or cold sauces, and individually quick-freezes (IQF) products with multiple packing options including printed film, retail boxes, and cartons. A topped line handles crusts of any size with similar sauce mixing and IQF capabilities. S&F also runs a dedicated gluten-free line with segregated storage, certified suppliers, and in-house and external allergen testing. Product offerings include the Original Pull-A-Part Topped Breadsticks and Dave’s Detroit Style Pizza, and the firm processes USDA commodities such as cheese, tomato paste, and flour.

S&F Foods serves institutional school foodservice programs, including the National School Lunch Program, and retail channels nationwide. Its products are distributed to schools and retail outlets across the country.

The company emphasizes food safety and quality, holding BRCGS AA Grade certification, USDA compliance, gluten-free certification from GFCO, and organic certification from Global Organic Alliance. Its mission highlights decades of experience producing safe, certified, and authentic products with ongoing reviews of food safety policies.
